description: FastAPI router module for managing defect reports, including CRUD operations, image uploads, RCA data, and corrective actions within a defect management system.

methods.name: _utc_now_iso
methods.description: Returns current UTC time in ISO format without microseconds.

methods.name: _uploads_public_base
methods.description: Constructs the base URL for public uploads from settings.

methods.name: _as_public_upload_url
methods.description: Converts a file path into a full URL for public access.

methods.name: _defect_to_out
methods.description: Converts a Defect object to its output schema including image URLs.

methods.name: _action_to_out
methods.description: Converts a CorrectiveAction object to its output schema.
